newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm oil market waits for tender price.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm oil market waits for tender price.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil and olein prices were little changed on Wednesday, traders said.
They said there was not much activity recorded in the market as traders were waiting for the outcome of a 500-tonne crude palm oil tender scheduled for this afternoon in Medan.
Crude palm oil was last tendered at 1,255 rupiah/kg last week.
One trader said news of a Pakistani rupee devaluation had so far had no effect on the domestic market although it managed to rattle Malaysian prices briefly.
"The whole focus is now on the tender which may give price direction in the short-term," the trader said.
Traders said prices were a bit soft for olein but they did not expect much downside.
Olein was quoted at 1,440 rupiah/kg in Medan, 1,480 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and 1,490 rupiah/kg in Surabaya.
